edits.new:
library(rstan)

rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

# Load data
data <- read.csv("/app/data.csv")
y <- as.integer(data$y)
n <- as.integer(data$n)
N <- length(y)

stan_data <- list(N = N, y = y, n = n)

# Initialize alpha, beta at positive values away from the improper region
init_fun <- function() {
  list(alpha = 2, beta = 20,
       theta = pmin(pmax((y + 0.5) / (n + 1), 0.01), 0.99))
}

fit <- rstan::sampling(
  stan_model(file = "/app/hierarchical_model.stan"),
  data = stan_data,
  chains = 4,
  iter = 100000,
  seed = 1,
  init = init_fun,
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 12)
)

# Extract posterior samples and compute posterior means
posterior <- rstan::extract(fit)
alpha_mean <- mean(posterior$alpha)
beta_mean <- mean(posterior$beta)

cat("Posterior mean alpha:", alpha_mean, "\n")
cat("Posterior mean beta:", beta_mean, "\n")

writeLines(format(alpha_mean, digits = 15), "/app/posterior_alpha_mean.txt")
writeLines(format(beta_mean, digits = 15), "/app/posterior_beta_mean.txt")

  init=function() list(alpha=2,beta=20,theta=pmin(pmax((d$y+0.5)/(d$n+1),0.01),0.99)))
p <- rstan::extract(f)
cat("alpha",mean(p$alpha),"beta",mean(p$beta),"\n")
' 2>&1 | tail -15
